name: Reusable scrapbook-style teen companion check-in scene
acceptanceCriteria: The canonical teen Room exposes a small scrapbook check-in launcher without replacing the illustrated Room with a dashboard.
One reusable companion scene renders Suhana, Sy, Cloud, or Night with warm-white paper, masking tape, doodles, a Polaroid-style frame, cozy dark-mode room art, and time-of-day-aware atmosphere.
Visible companion copy uses Suhana, Sy, Cloud, and Night while raylene and rylane remain compatibility-only internal identifiers.
The first approved Sy evening composition keeps the note 'you made it through today.' and a Bip-with-companion CTA while preserving the existing Pages destination.
This UI slice adds no Supabase, Worker, auth, telemetry, parent-visibility, journal-read, microphone, or private-data boundary.

rollout.controlKey: ScrapbookCheckInLauncher on the canonical teen Room

verification.blocker: The dedicated exact-head Playwright witness must pass and produce the 390x844 Sy evening screenshot; that screenshot still needs visual comparison against the approved reference together with the remaining exact-head repository/release gates before verified or released status.

rollback: Revert the scrapbook companion check-in feature merge. Remove the route registration, hidden tab entry, Room launcher, scene component, design reference, canon document, contract test, dedicated Playwright witness, Founder Preview catalog entry, and this ledger extension; no database or provider rollback is required.
